notes.title: 🌱 Growing Bigger: Land Expansion Update!
notes.notes:
Another week, another update! 😄


This time I’ve been working on the land expansion system, it’s now in place, though I’m still polishing and fine-tuning the details.



What’s next:

I’ll be wrapping up the land expansion and then moving on to refactoring and polishing the building system to make it as smooth and enjoyable as possible!



📌 Don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist, join our Discord community, and follow the weekly devlogs!

See you next week! 👋
